reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Missouri
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant if the property is made uninhabitable?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (scenario + minimal general structure)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Scenario identifiers
state(missouri).
focus_year(2021).

landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
property(p1).
lease(lease1).

lease_of(lease1, l1, t1, p1).

% Factual statement in the question: the property is made uninhabitable.
property_condition(p1, uninhabitable).

% Additional facts to make the scenario fully specified for the statutory tests:
% (No other statutory eviction triggers are present.)
rent_monthly_total(lease1, 1200).          % includes tenant rent + any subsidy (if any)
rent_is_in_default(lease1, no).            % tenant is not in rent default
lease_terminated(lease1, no).              % lease term has not ended / not terminated
tenant_holding_over_after_termination(t1, no).
written_demand_to_vacate_made(t1, no).
tenant_refused_after_written_demand(t1, no).

% Illegal-use/controlled-substances/gambling/bawdyhouse grounds not present
illegal_gaming_on_premises(lease1, no).
bawdyhouse_brothel_common_gaming_house(lease1, no).
illegal_controlled_substances_on_premises(lease1, no).

% 441.740 immediate eviction grounds not present
drug_related_criminal_activity_on_or_within_property(t1, no).
used_property_to_further_drug_activity(t1, no).
tenant_household_or_guest_drug_activity_nearby(t1, no).
tenant_invited_barred_person(t1, no).
tenant_failed_to_notify_barred_person_returned(t1, no).

% Emergency-type immediate eviction not present
emergency_situation_exists(t1, no).
reasonable_attempt_to_abate_by_law_enforcement(l1, t1, no).
imminent_physical_injury_risk_to_others_or_lessor(t1, no).
imminent_physical_damage_risk_to_lessor_property(t1, no).
reasonable_repair_cost_if_damage_occurs(t1, 0).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario helper predicate (Requirement #2)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the factual statement (and the scenario context)
% encoded above is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    state(missouri),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    property(p1),
    lease(lease1),
    lease_of(lease1, l1, t1, p1),
    property_condition(p1, uninhabitable).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (Requirement #1)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
    [1] MO Rev Stat  441.020 (2021)
    Illegal use of premises renders lease void; lessor may recover as holding over.
*/
statute_441_020_illegal_use_renders_lease_void(Lease) :-
    lease(Lease),
    (
        illegal_gaming_on_premises(Lease, yes)
    ;
        bawdyhouse_brothel_common_gaming_house(Lease, yes)
    ;
        illegal_controlled_substances_on_premises(Lease, yes)
    ).

/*
    [2] MO Rev Stat  441.740 (2021)
    Court shall order immediate eviction if it finds listed grounds.
    Emergency subdivision requires reasonable attempt to abate via law enforcement/mental health.
*/
statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, emergency) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    emergency_situation_exists(Tenant, yes),
    reasonable_attempt_to_abate_by_law_enforcement(l1, Tenant, yes),
    (
        imminent_physical_injury_risk_to_others_or_lessor(Tenant, yes)
    ;
        (
            imminent_physical_damage_risk_to_lessor_property(Tenant, yes),
            statute_441_740_damage_cost_exceeds_twelve_months_rent(lease1, Tenant)
        )
    ).

statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, drug_activity_on_or_within_property) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    drug_related_criminal_activity_on_or_within_property(Tenant, yes).

statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, used_property_to_further_drug_activity) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    used_property_to_further_drug_activity(Tenant, yes).

statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, household_or_guest_drug_activity_nearby) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    tenant_household_or_guest_drug_activity_nearby(Tenant, yes).

statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, invited_barred_person) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    tenant_invited_barred_person(Tenant, yes).

statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, failed_to_notify_barred_person_returned) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    tenant_failed_to_notify_barred_person_returned(Tenant, yes).

% Helper for  441.740(1)(b): repair cost exceeds an amount equal to twelve months of rent.
% "rent" includes tenant amount + any subsidy; modeled as rent_monthly_total/2.
statute_441_740_damage_cost_exceeds_twelve_months_rent(Lease, Tenant) :-
    lease(Lease),
    tenant(Tenant),
    rent_monthly_total(Lease, MonthlyTotal),
    reasonable_repair_cost_if_damage_occurs(Tenant, RepairCost),
    Threshold is MonthlyTotal * 12,
    RepairCost > Threshold.

/*
    [3] MO Rev Stat  534.030 (2021)
    Unlawful detainer includes willfully holding over after termination,
    or refusing to vacate after written demand by the person with legal right.
*/
statute_534_030_unlawful_detainer(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    tenant_holding_over_after_termination(Tenant, yes).

statute_534_030_unlawful_detainer(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    written_demand_to_vacate_made(Tenant, yes),
    tenant_refused_after_written_demand(Tenant, yes).

/*
    [4] MO Rev Stat  535.010 (2021)
    If rent not paid as agreed (default), landlord may dispossess and recover possession.
*/
statute_535_010_rent_default_allows_dispossession(Lease) :-
    lease(Lease),
    rent_is_in_default(Lease, yes).

/*
    [5] MO Rev Stat  441.030 (2021)
    Tenant duties: no assignment without written assent; no lease-condition violations; no waste.
    (This statute states duties but does not itself specify an eviction remedy in the excerpt.)
*/
statute_441_030_tenant_duty_no_unauthorized_assignment(_Lease) :-
    true.

statute_441_030_tenant_duty_no_lease_condition_violation(_Lease) :-
    true.

statute_441_030_tenant_duty_no_waste(_Lease) :-
    true.

/*
    [6] MO Rev Stat  441.070 (2021)
    No notice to quit necessary when term ends at a certain time, or notice dispensed with.
    (Procedural; not an independent eviction ground.)
*/
statute_441_070_no_notice_to_quit_necessary_when_term_ends_certain_time(Lease) :-
    lease(Lease),
    lease_terminated(Lease, yes).

/*
    [7] MO Rev Stat  535.020 (2021)
    Procedure for rent-demand and filing; not required to give 441.060 notice for Ch. 535.
    (Procedural; not an independent eviction ground.)
*/
statute_535_020_procedure_available_for_unpaid_rent(Lease) :-
    lease(Lease),
    statute_535_010_rent_default_allows_dispossession(Lease).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: eviction grounds derived from the translated statutes (Requirement #3)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% eviction_basis/4: Landlord may evict Tenant from Property because of Basis.
% Ordered with cuts to keep determinism.
eviction_basis(Landlord, Tenant, Property, lease_void_illegal_use_441_020) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    property(Property),
    lease_of(Lease, Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    statute_441_020_illegal_use_renders_lease_void(Lease),
    !.

eviction_basis(Landlord, Tenant, Property, immediate_eviction_441_740(Basis)) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    property(Property),
    lease_of(_Lease, Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    statute_441_740_immediate_eviction_ground(Tenant, Basis),
    !.

eviction_basis(Landlord, Tenant, Property, unlawful_detainer_534_030) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    property(Property),
    lease_of(_Lease, Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    statute_534_030_unlawful_detainer(Tenant),
    !.

eviction_basis(Landlord, Tenant, Property, rent_default_535_010) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    property(Property),
    lease_of(Lease, Landlord, Tenant, Property),
    statute_535_010_rent_default_allows_dispossession(Lease),
    !.

% eviction_permitted/3 succeeds if *any* statutory eviction basis applies.
eviction_permitted(Landlord, Tenant, Property) :-
    eviction_basis(Landlord, Tenant, Property, _AnyBasis),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer (Requirement #4)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% The question asks whether the landlord can evict *because the property is uninhabitable*.
% Under the provided statutes, "uninhabitable" by itself is not an eviction ground.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_permitted(l1, t1, p1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ eviction_permitted(l1, t1, p1),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (Requirement #5)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant if the property is made uninhabitable?
